notes: English default:42831 names the cave of Amethyn beneath the Winter King's court, and default:23461/24897 names Gadflow's crystalline fortress of Amethyn. Default:1091/15600 places Tirnoch's imprisonment between worlds there. These identify the shared place-name component, not a claim that every named chamber and fortress label is interchangeable. Japanese アメシン and Chinese 阿梅辛 corroborate 아메신, the dominant Korean form, rather than 아메틴. Register Amethyn Castle, Heart of Amethyn and Deep Amethyn as distinct complete source labels; Japanese アメシン城, アメシン中心部, アメシン深部 and Chinese 阿梅辛城堡, 阿梅辛之心, 深邃阿梅辛 corroborate their local roles. Use 아메신 성, 아메신의 심장, and 아메신 심부 respectively, with complete English annotations and no nested parentheses. The official Korean manual PDF p. 1 supplies the Winter Court/war setting and p. 7 the main-quest framework, not these individual location labels. All three resources were searched.
